DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの展望エリアをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which observation area would you like?

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内に三百五十とあるので、エレベーターの三百五十階を探しています。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 高さ数字を停止階と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.translation: The information says three hundred fifty, so I'm looking for the elevator to the three-hundred-fiftieth floor.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the height number for a floor where the elevator stops. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その数字は高さの案内です。停止階の番号ではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-03.translation: That number indicates the height. It isn't a stopping-floor number.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 階数だと思っていました。入場券にあるエリア名で乗る場所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券のエリア名で乗場確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was the floor number. I'd like to check where to board using the area name on my admission ticket.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check the boarding point using the area name on the ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券のエリアと、この乗場を照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's match the area on your ticket with this boarding point.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 券はこちらです。高さが近い表示の別施設へ行くのでなく、施設名も合わせます。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別施設と混同せず券の施設名も照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here's my ticket. I'll match the facility name too, rather than going to a different facility showing a similar height.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Match the facility name on the ticket too, without confusing it with another facility. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが対象の乗場です。追加の展望エリアは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the applicable boarding point. We'll check additional observation areas separately.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の券で全部の高さまで行けるとは考えません。今日は対象エリアだけにします。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加エリアを含むと決めず現券の範囲を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume my current ticket takes me to every height. Today I'll just use the area it covers.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the current ticket's scope without assuming additional areas are included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰る時の乗場も、上で案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the information upstairs for where to board on your return.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。高さと停止階を混ぜず、券の施設とエリアで往復の乗場を確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 高さと階を分け帰りの案内も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't mix up height and stopping floors. I'll check both outward and return boarding points using the facility and area on my ticket.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish height from floors and check the return instructions too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この乗場の案内に従ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUMIDA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please proceed following the instructions for this boarding point.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 名前を入れる前に位置を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's check the position before adding your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今持っている向きで下に書けばよいですか。完成時もこの向きだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作業時の向きで名前を入れる位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Should I write it at the bottom in the orientation I'm holding it now? I thought it would face this way when finished too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to add your name based on the working orientation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 完成時の上下は見本で確認します。作業中の持ち方と同じとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the finished top and bottom against the sample. They aren't necessarily the same as how you hold it while working.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上下を確認せず印を付けそうでした。まだ付けていないので、完成時の上を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未記入を伝え完成時の上下を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I nearly marked it without checking the top and bottom. I haven't marked it yet, so please show me the top in the finished position.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not written on it and check the finished orientation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが上です。名前を入れる面も別に案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the top. I'll separately explain which side your name goes on too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 正面に大きく入れるつもりでした。裏面に入れる指定なら、文字の大きさも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記名面と文字サイズの指定を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was planning to put it large on the front. If it's supposed to go on the back, I'd also like to ask about the letter size.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the designated name side and lettering size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この範囲へ入れます。まず練習板で配置を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It goes within this area. First, please show the layout on the practice board.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本番の面へ先に彫らず、練習板へ名前の向きと大きさを示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 練習板で向きと配置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't carve the actual surface first. I'll show the name's orientation and size on the practice board.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the orientation and layout on the practice board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配置は確認できました。実物への作業は、道具の説明後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The layout is confirmed. Work on the actual piece comes after the tool explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では作品の上下と裏面の位置を言い返して確認し、道具の説明を受けてから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上下と面を復唱し道具説明後に始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll repeat back the top, bottom and position on the back to confirm, and start after receiving the tool explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat the orientation and side and start after the tool explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で進めましょう。本番の材料はまだ置いておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's proceed in that order. Please leave the actual material aside for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会場の移動についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about moving around the venue?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 後ろから音が聞こえるので、列を戻ってそちらへ行こうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音の方向へ列を戻る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can hear sound behind me, so I was planning to go back along the line and head that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to go back along the line toward the sound. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 音だけで進路を決めず、会場の案内に従ってください。列を逆へ進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please follow the venue instructions rather than choosing a route from the sound alone. Don't move against the line.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ戻っていません。音の方向と案内経路が違って見えたので、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未逆行と伝え案内経路の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't gone back yet. The sound direction and the signed route seemed different, so I'd like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not gone against the flow and ask to check the designated route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の通行経路はこちらです。同行者はご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the current route. Is your companion with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同行者は先へ進んでいます。自分だけ逆へ戻らず、まず同じ案内経路で動くと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者と同じ指定方向で動くと連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My companion has gone ahead. Rather than going backward alone, I'll tell them I'm first moving along the same designated route.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your companion you will move in the same designated direction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡は流れを妨げない場所で行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please contact them from somewhere that doesn't obstruct the flow.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 係の案内する場所で伝えます。音が近い場所が空いているとも思い込まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行を妨げず連絡し空き状況を音で推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell them from the place the staff member directs me to. I'll also avoid assuming that an area closer to the sound is unoccupied.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Contact them without obstructing passage and do not infer availability from sound. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見物場所は現地の誘導で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the viewing locations through the guidance on site.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。音を頼りに列を横切らず、同行者へ現在地を知らせて誘導どおり進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地を共有し誘導に従って進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't cut across the line following the sound. I'll tell my companion where I am and proceed as directed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share your current location and proceed according to guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの方向へお進みください。必要な時は近くの係へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go in this direction. You can check with a nearby staff member when needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ボール用の袋をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a bag for a ball?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見本が小さいので、この袋に入ると思いました。使う時もこの大きさですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未膨張の見本寸法で袋を選んだと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sample is small, so I thought it would fit in this bag. It's this size when used too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you chose a bag using the dimensions of the uninflated sample. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その見本は空気を入れていません。使用時の寸法を表示で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: That sample hasn't been inflated. Let's check the label for its dimensions when in use.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: しぼんだ状態を使う大きさと考えていました。空気を入れた時のサイズを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 膨張後のサイズ確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought its deflated size was its size in use. I'd like to ask its size after inflation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check the inflated size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品の表示はこちらです。お持ちのボールと同じ製品ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here's this product's label. Is your ball the same product?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家の物は別です。見本の数字をそのまま使わず、家の製品表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家の別製品の表示を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The one at home is different. I won't use the sample's numbers as they are; I'll check the label on my product at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will check the label of the different product at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の対応サイズも控えておけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can note down the bag's compatible sizes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方の表示を比べます。無理に押し込んだり、収納のためだけに自己判断で空気を抜いたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋とボールの条件を比べ無理な収納を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll compare both labels. I won't force the ball in or decide myself to deflate it just for storage.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the bag and ball conditions and avoid forced storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は袋の購入を待ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you wait before buying the bag for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。家のボールの使用状態と寸法を確認し、この袋の条件に合うか分かってから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅寸法確認まで袋購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll check my ball's state in use and dimensions at home, and buy once I know whether it meets this bag's conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off buying the bag until you have checked the dimensions at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では対応サイズを控えてご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please note the compatible sizes and consider it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品の受取り時刻を確認したいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check what time you can collect your piece?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予定表では窯が空いています。今開けて作品を取り出してよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予定表の空きから窯を開けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The timetable shows the kiln is free. I thought I could open it now and take out my piece.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a free slot on the timetable means you can open the kiln. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約表の空きと、窯の状態は別です。担当の確認前に開けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: A free slot on the booking sheet and the kiln's condition are separate matters. Don't open it before the staff member checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。空き枠が安全な取出しの許可だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触と空き枠の誤解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't touched it yet. I thought a free slot meant permission to take it out safely.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not touched it and explain your misunderstanding about a free slot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 温度や工程は担当が確認します。どの作品のことですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the temperature and process. Which piece do you mean?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この受付番号の作品です。隣の窯の作品もまとめて取るつもりにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作品番号を示し別窯の物を含めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The piece with this intake number. I don't intend to collect pieces from the neighboring kiln together with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the piece number and do not include items in another kiln. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その番号で確認します。受取り予定は人に伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check using that number. Have you told anyone when you plan to collect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日渡すと友人へ言いましたが、まだ確定していません。確認中と訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人への未確定受渡し連絡を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I told my friend I'd give it to them today, but it's not confirmed yet. I'll correct that and say it's being checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct your unconfirmed handover message to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が取り出しと受渡しの予定を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain the plans for removal and handover.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。窯へ触れず、該当番号の受渡しが確認できてから友人へ改めて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状態と受渡し確認まで窯に触れず待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't touch the kiln, and I'll contact my friend again after collection for the relevant number is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait without touching the kiln until its condition and handover are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その作品の工程を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll ask the staff member about that piece's process.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの野菜をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for these vegetables?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 赤い袋は甘い種類だと思い、そちらを選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋色を味や品種の表示と思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I chose the red bag because I thought it meant a sweet variety.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you took the bag color to indicate flavor or variety. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の色だけでは種類は判断できません。品名と表示を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can't determine the variety from the bag color alone. Let's look at the product name and label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 色を味の区分だと思っていました。二つの品名を確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二袋の品名照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the colors classified the flavor. Could you check the names on these two bags?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the product names on the two bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材では同じ品名です。袋の中の本数は違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this learning scenario, they have the same product name. The number of vegetables in the bags differs.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 味の違いではなく本数も見て選びます。今日は二人で使うので、多い方を必ず選ぶ必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 味区分を訂正し本数と用途で選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll choose by looking at the number too rather than a flavor difference. There are two of us using them today, so I don't necessarily need the larger bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the flavor-category misunderstanding and choose by quantity and intended use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使う量や保管の予定に合わせてご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consider how much you'll use and your storage plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一度で使う予定です。少ない袋の内容を見て、傷の状態も確認してから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一回使用に合わせ少量袋の状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to use them in one go. I'd like to look at the contents of the smaller bag and check for damage before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the smaller bag's condition to suit one-time use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この袋の表示と中身をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at this bag's label and contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 少ない方にします。袋色を味の保証として家族に伝えず、表示を確認した品として持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少量を選び色で味を保証しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the smaller one. I won't tell my family the bag color guarantees the flavor; I'll take it home as an item whose label I've checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the smaller quantity without guaranteeing taste from color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その袋をお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 到着予定についてご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about your expected arrival?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕食が六時とあるので、六時までに着けば手続きも食事も間に合うと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕食時刻までに到着すればよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says dinner is at six, so I thought arriving by six would leave enough time for both check-in and dinner.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether arriving by the dinner time is enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 夕食の開始とチェックインの案内は別です。ご到着の見込みを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The start of dinner and check-in instructions are separate. Please tell us your expected arrival time.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六時ちょうどになりそうです。食事時刻を到着期限と同じに読んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見込み時刻と誤読を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It looks like I'll arrive at exactly six. I had read the meal time as the same thing as an arrival deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your estimated time and the misreading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が受付と食事の状況を確認します。まだ移動中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check reception and dinner arrangements. Are you still traveling?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。無理に急いで確定時刻を約束せず、今の交通状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動中の交通状況を伝え無理な時刻約束をしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than rushing unreasonably and promising a definite time, I'll explain the current traffic situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the traffic situation while traveling and avoid an unrealistic promise about timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 夕食の変更ができるかも担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll also ask the staff member whether dinner can be changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらから食事を遅らせられると決めず、可能な対応と条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食事延期の可否と条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't decide myself that the meal can be delayed. I'd like to ask what arrangements are possible and under what conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether dinner can be delayed and the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後にご案内します。予約名を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain after checking. Please give the booking name.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約名はこちらです。到着見込みと食事の扱いを確認してから同行者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約名で到着食事の対応を確認し同行者へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's the booking name. I'll tell my companions after checking the expected arrival and how dinner will be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the booking name to check arrival and dinner arrangements and tell your companions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その予約で担当が確認します。食事時刻だけで到着の扱いを決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will check that booking. Please don't determine how arrival is handled from the dinner time alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 割合の欄についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to ask about the percentage field, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族と半分ずつ払うので、住宅の持分も半分と書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払割合を持分欄へ記入したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family member and I are paying half each, so I wrote half for the ownership share of the home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you entered the payment proportion in the ownership-share field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払いの話と登記などの情報は分けて確認します。資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check payment arrangements separately from registration and other information. Do you have documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持分の資料があります。自分の話した支払割合をそのまま書くのでなく、資料を見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持分の資料で確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have documents showing the ownership share. Rather than just writing the payment proportion I mentioned, I'd like you to look at the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request checking against the ownership-share documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。実際の支払い記録も別にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check. Do you also have separate records of the actual payments?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。資料の数字と違う所があるので、どちらかを消して合わせず両方示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実払記録と資料の相違を消さず示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do. Some figures differ from the documents, so I'll show both without deleting either to make them match.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the differences between actual payment records and documents without erasing them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象となる申告と、必要な確認を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain the applicable declaration and the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 半分と書いた用紙も残します。自己判断で割合だけ直して提出しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誤記用紙を残し自己訂正だけで提出しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll also keep the form where I wrote half. I'll avoid just changing the percentage myself and submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the incorrectly filled form and do not submit based only on your own correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家族の資料を使う場合も、必要な範囲を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you use your family member's documents too, please check what scope is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の持分資料と支払い記録を分けて見せ、対象と訂正方法を確認してから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象と訂正方法を二資料で担当に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll show my ownership documents and payment records separately and proceed after checking what applies and how to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check applicability and the correction method with the staff member using both documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当へご案内します。二つの割合を分けて説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUMIDA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll take you to the staff member. Please explain the two proportions separately.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの御朱印帳を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I check your temple and shrine seal book?

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この空白にお願いしたいです。隣のページの印が少し写っていますが、空いています。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 裏写りのある空白ページへの記入希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like it written in this blank space. A little of the seal on the neighboring page has transferred onto it, but it's empty.
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request writing on a blank page with transferred ink showing through. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ページの状態と受付できる方法を担当が確認します。こちらへ記入位置を指示する前にお見せください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member will check the page condition and the available way to accept your request. Please show it before specifying the writing position.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 裏写りのあるページでもそのまま書けると決めつけていました。帳面を見ていただきます。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空白だけで記入可能と判断せず帳面を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had assumed you could write directly on a page even with transferred ink. I'll let you look at the book.
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the book rather than deciding blank space alone makes writing possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この見開きは折り目にも汚れがあります。別の方法をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is dirt in the fold of this spread too. Would you prefer another method?

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帳面を無理に広げて押さえることはしたくありません。別紙で受けられるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帳面を押し広げず別紙の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want to force the book open and press it down. I'd like to ask whether I can receive it on a separate sheet.
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether a separate sheet is available without forcing the book open. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別紙の扱いは当日の案内で確認します。受け取った後の貼り付けは、ご自身で検討してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the day's instructions for separate sheets. Please consider for yourself how to attach it after receiving it.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付で貼ってもらうことまで頼まず、まず別紙の可否を確認します。帳面は自分でしまってよいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貼付依頼は含めず帳面をしまえるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't include a request for the desk to attach it. First I'll check whether a separate sheet is possible. May I put my book away myself?
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can put the book away, without including a request to attach the sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。別紙での受付方法を担当が説明しますので、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The staff member will explain how requests for separate sheets are accepted, so please wait as you are.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帳面をしまいました。説明を聞き、別紙でお願いするか決めてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別紙の説明後に申込方法を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've put the book away. I'll hear the explanation and apply after deciding whether to request a separate sheet.
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will decide how to apply after the separate-sheet explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。空白があることだけで記入可能とはせず、方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-TAITO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's check the method rather than treating blank space alone as enough to allow writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 着付けで分かりにくいところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything unclear about putting on the kimono?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真では右側が上に見えます。今、教えていただいた重ね方は逆ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真と説明の左右が逆に見えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: In the photo, the right side looks like it's on top. Isn't the overlap you just taught me the other way around?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the photo and the explanation seem to have left and right reversed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その写真は鏡越しに撮ったものかもしれません。写真の左右だけで決めず、ご自身の衿で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That photo may have been taken through a mirror. Rather than deciding by left and right in the photo alone, let's check using your own collar.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鏡の映り方で混乱していました。自分の左の衿がどちらか、手で指して確認してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の左の衿を身体で確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The mirror image was confusing me. May I point with my hand to check which is my own left collar?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check your own left collar using your body as the reference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。こちらがご自身の左です。左の衿を上に重ねる説明を、もう一度示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. This is your own left. I'll show you again how to overlap the left collar on top.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。衿を重ねたまま帯を締める前に、形を見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帯の前に衿の重なりを見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. With the collars overlapped, I'd like you to check the shape before I tighten the sash.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Have the collar overlap checked before the sash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認します。強く引かず、今の状態で少し楽にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check. Don't pull hard; please loosen it a little from its current state.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 苦しくない位置に緩めました。写真の見た目に合わせて、もう一度逆にしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 苦しくないよう緩め鏡の左右で逆転させないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've loosened it to a comfortable position. I'll avoid reversing it again to match how the photo looks.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Loosen it comfortably and say you will not reverse it based on the mirror's left and right. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この状態で試着を続けられます。ご自身で着る時の説明も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can continue trying it on like this. Do you also need instructions for dressing yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。鏡の左右ではなく自分の左の衿を基準にした説明をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 身体基準の着付け説明をメモしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'd like to note down an explanation based on my own left collar, rather than left and right in the mirror.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to note down dressing instructions using your body as the reference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その言葉で手順を書きましょう。帯の扱いも続けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's write the steps using those words. I'll continue with guidance on the sash too.
